100 original new fictional lives, written from age 4 to 16 without the questionnaire or engine. Separate response inference and frozen files make assumptions inspectable. An additional 24 new lives address gaps found in the original 100. The original 100 histories and answers remain frozen. The original 24 older models also remain unchanged; their biography-based reinterpretations are separate.

70 development cases; 30 held out until the candidate rules are frozen. These are not representative students, every possible variation, or evidence of predictive accuracy.
